gitCommit.body:
docs: 11-07 evening record — #740 MAG alert/presale fix, bad49a91 corrected (#741)

* docs: 2026-11-07 morning routine — queues 0/0, 11 findings suppressed, curator fold

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENy7mcyRcPVBTHa8uTL

* fix(security-review): require a concrete exploit for medium+ PR findings

The #728 false HIGH ("path traversal" in safeInboxBatch) and both false
MEDIUMs were hypotheses with no harmful input -> result; the reviewer had the
full files. A medium/high/critical finding now needs exploit {attacker, entry,
input, result}; without it the finding is stored as suppressed with a reason
(auditable, out of the open queue). The prompt names the four false-positive
shapes and the admin trust model. The insert response is now checked.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENy7mcyRcPVBTHa8uTL

* feat(shipping): GrabExpress API integration, built from Grab's official docs (switched off)

Ready for when sandbox credentials arrive; nothing calls Grab until
GRAB_EXPRESS_CLIENT_ID / _CLIENT_SECRET / _CONTACT_EMAIL are set, and the
manual "Move to Grab Express" flow stays as the fallback.

- lib/grab-express.ts: OAuth client-credentials token (7-day, cached, one
  refresh on 401), sandbox/production paths (fails closed to sandbox),
  create / get / cancel / cancel-by-order / quotes, X-Request-ID logged on
  every call, constant-time webhook credential check (fails closed).
- lib/shipping/grab-express-mapping.ts (pure): Grab states -> our
  shipper_status (both CANCELED spellings), the Create Delivery body. No
  contents or value declared; our ops email for sender and recipient.
- lib/shipping/grab-book.ts + action "book" on the Grab admin route: same
  gates as Lalamove (packed, gold not awaited), COD refused, guarded save,
  and a trip we booked but could not record is voided.
- /api/webhooks/grab-express: our two credentials; delivered/failed applied
  only when Grab's Get Details agrees; IN_RETURN pages the admins.
- /api/cron/grab-express-status-poll (5 min): the convergence spine.
- Cancel booking for API trips (before a driver accepts); Dispatch shows
  Book with Grab / Cancel booking only when the API is connected; a failed
  Grab trip now returns to Awaiting instead of vanishing.
- Shared onCourierDelivered (SPX webhook + poll now use it) and shopOrigin
  (one pickup identity for Lalamove and Grab).
- docs/grab-express-api-reference.md: the contract as we use it, our
  choices, and the go-live checklist.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENy7mcyRcPVBTHa8uTL

* feat(shipping): high-value threshold in Admin → Shippers + hand-over instruction on every courier

Mukesh, 2026-11-07: "high value for anything above $500, admin configurable"
and "Handover to person, don't leave outside" (couriers have been leaving
parcels at the door without ringing).

- Migration 20261107_courier_high_value_threshold: shipper_settings
  .high_value_threshold_sgd (0-100000, NULL = never) + a 'grab' settings row
  seeded S$500 (notes NULL: notes print on receipts). Not a checkout option.
- Admin → Shippers → High-value parcels: SPX and Grab thresholds. Dispatch
  pre-ticks Grab "High value" and SPX "Declare parcel value" by the threshold
  (goods = gold + accessories before discounts, the SPX rule, now shared in
  lib/shipping/handover.ts); the operator can change it per order. SPX is
  left unset (unchanged) - declaring turns on SPX insurance collection.
- HANDOVER_INSTRUCTION on Lalamove recipients[].remarks (single + multi-stop),
  SPX deliver_instruction, NinjaVan delivery_instructions, and Grab sender /
  recipient instruction + package description.
- GRAB_EXPRESS_HIGH_VALUE / _PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION env removed: the threshold
  and fixed neutral wording replace them.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENy7mcyRcPVBTHa8uTL

* docs: Airwallex integration design from the official docs (decisions D1-D6 pending)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENy7mcyRcPVBTHa8uTL

* feat(payments): Airwallex as a third hosted gateway (Checkout Session, all methods inactive)

Mukesh, 2026-11-07: build Airwallex like Razorpay, Checkout Session, every
method enabled on the sandbox; limits, order and rates are Admin settings.

- lib/airwallex.ts: cached login token (re-login on 401), Checkout Session
  create/retrieve (x-api-version 2026-05-29), PaymentIntent read, fee from the
  financial-transactions ledger, webhook HMAC (x-timestamp + raw body, 5-min
  window, fails closed). One session = the one method priced at checkout.
- /api/payments/airwallex/create (shared create handler, AW- refs), status,
  /api/webhooks/airwallex (verify, find row, ack, reconcile in background),
  airwallex-reconcile (10 min) + airwallex-pending-cleanup (hourly) crons,
  payment-monitor stuck rule.
- Migration 20261107b_airwallex: airwallex_pending_payments (RLS, service
  only), orders session/intent ids, payment_method CHECK, 9 fee rows
  is_active=false with placeholder rates, create_order_atomic regenerated
  with the two id columns (drift test now checks every gateway's fields).
- lib/payments/online-gateways.ts: one registry for hosted gateways (method
  prefix, ref prefix/param, routes, pending table). Checkout, confirming page,
  pending resolver, MAG redeem release and receipts read it, so an AW- ref
  can never release the MAG hold of a paid order via the HitPay table.
- lib/payments/gateway-runners.ts: Razorpay's status handler and two crons
  extracted unchanged and shared with Airwallex.
- iOS (ships in 1.0.12): PaymentGateway.airwallex, logos, labels, aw_ref,
  x-gateways adds airwallex; older apps never see airwallex_* methods.
- Architecture doc counts, design doc decisions + go-live checklist.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENy7mcyRcPVBTHa8uTL

* feat(payments): Airwallex card offers Apple Pay / Google Pay by device, like HitPay

Mukesh, 2026-11-07: Apple Pay and Google Pay should appear on the hosted page
depending on the customer's device, as with HitPay - not as separate methods.

- airwallex_card sessions offer card + applepay + googlepay; Airwallex shows a
  wallet only where the device / browser supports it (hosted page: no Apple
  Pay domain registration). Other sessions stay restricted to their method.
- The mismatch alert accepts a wallet on a card order.
- Migration 20261107c: removes the two never-active wallet rows (guarded),
  narrows the payment_method CHECK, card note updated. DEV verified.
- Card mark shows Apple Pay + Google Pay (web + iOS); the accepted strip
  draws the wallet card from HitPay first, else Airwallex.
- API version 2026-08-21 (the account's latest; matches the webhook).
- Design doc: scoped-key permissions and the four webhook events.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENy7mcyRcPVBTHa8uTL

* fix(admin): Payment fees shows every provider (Airwallex was hidden)

Mukesh, 2026-11-07: no Airwallex methods in Admin on DEV. The panel grouped
rows only for a fixed provider list (hitpay, razorpay, stripe, uob, manual),
so any other provider's rows were silently dropped. lib/payments/provider-order
keeps the preferred order and appends any unknown provider, so a new gateway
can never vanish again (tested).

Checkout: Airwallex card shows the same "Apple Pay & Google Pay on supported
devices" note as HitPay card.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENy7mcyRcPVBTHa8uTL

* feat(admin): fetch Airwallex's official payment-method logos (button on Payment fees)

Mukesh, 2026-11-07: go ahead with the logo fetch button. Our workspace cannot
reach Airwallex, so the fetch runs on the server an admin is using.

- lib/airwallex.ts listPaymentMethodTypes(): GET /pa/config/payment_method_types
  for SGD / SG one-off with __resources (the logo URLs Airwallex's own SDKs use).
- lib/airwallex-logos.ts: downloads only from https *.airwallex.com URLs that
  API returned, checks content type + 512 KB cap, refuses SVGs with script,
  event handlers, foreignObject, javascript: or external references, stores
  them in the private brand-assets bucket, returns 1-hour preview links.
- POST /api/admin/payment-fees/airwallex-logos (admin only; 409 when Airwallex
  is not configured; 502 without detail when Airwallex fails).
- Admin -> Payment fees -> Airwallex: "Fetch official logos" with previews.
- Migration 20261107d: private brand-assets bucket (svg/png, 512 KB). DEV applied.

Nothing customer-facing reads the bucket; the marks are reviewed and committed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENy7mcyRcPVBTHa8uTL

* feat(payments): official WeChat Pay, Alipay, SPayLater, Airwallex Pay marks

Fetched by Mukesh from DEV (Admin -> Payment fees -> Fetch official logos,
2026-11-07): Airwallex's own marks from its payment_method_types API. Reviewed:
plain vector paths, no script / handlers / external references.

- Web: public/images/payment/{wechatpay,alipay,spaylater,airwallex-pay}.svg as
  self-framed marks (like Atome); the temporary text chips are removed. The
  accepted-payments strip now includes all four.
- iOS (1.0.12): PayLogoWechatpay / Alipay / Spaylater / AirwallexPay at 175x120,
  rendered from the SVGs (Airwallex's PNGs are 70x48, too small), same aspect
  ratio as the web marks (parity test).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENy7mcyRcPVBTHa8uTL

* feat(payments): "Powered by Airwallex" mark, like Razorpay's

Mukesh, 2026-11-07: Airwallex methods need the same powered-by treatment as
the other providers. Airwallex's own header wordmark (airwallex.com), text
reversed to white for the dark background (Razorpay's white-variant
treatment); the gradient mark is unchanged. Web: PAYMENT_PROVIDER_LOGOS
(checkout rows + Admin -> Payment fees). iOS (1.0.12): PayLogoAirwallex 875x120,
"Powered by" + mark at h14 in the payment picker.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENy7mcyRcPVBTHa8uTL

* fix(airwallex): drop hosted_completion_page from Checkout Session create

DEV sandbox, 2026-11-07: Airwallex 400 validation_error "hosted_completion_page
is only applicable when ui_mode is HOSTED and the checkout creates an invoice
or saves a Payment Source". A plain PAYMENT session redirects to success_url
on completion anyway, so the field is removed (test pins its absence).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENy7mcyRcPVBTHa8uTL

* feat(airwallex): fill in gateway fees posted after completion

Mukesh, 2026-11-07: build the fee backfill. On the DEV sandbox none of the
first three paid Airwallex orders had a fee: completion reads the fee once,
and Airwallex had not posted the ledger row yet (no error, so not a scope
problem).

- lib/airwallex-fee-backfill.ts: recent (14 d) Airwallex orders with no fee,
  oldest first, 25 per run; fee read by the payment attempt
  (source_type PAYMENT_ATTEMPT); recordAirwallexFee never overwrites.
- Runs inside the existing airwallex-reconcile cron (10 min) via a new
  optional afterReconcile hook on the shared gateway runner; its counts join
  the cron response/log, a failure is logged and never fails the cron.
- paymentFeeSgd: ignores CANCELLED rows, and a PENDING row with no fee yet is
  "unknown" (null), not a free payment, so a wrong 0 is never locked in.
- recordAirwallexFee returns whether the write succeeded (honest counts).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENy7mcyRcPVBTHa8uTL

* docs: 2026-11-07 day close — 11-08 agenda, Airwallex record, SDUI §237

- CLAUDE.md: agenda moved to 2026-11-08 (all open items carried); Airwallex
  go-live steps + fee-backfill check on the first live payment; 1.0.12 now
  includes §237; closed record for the 11-07 session (#731-#739, DEV
  sandbox test, batch-to-prod process, session limits).
- SDUI contract §237: Airwallex native gateway built in source for 1.0.12,
  x-gateways gating keeps <=1.0.11 apps safe.
- Airwallex design doc: status + §8 sandbox findings.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENy7mcyRcPVBTHa8uTL

* fix(alerts): new-order alert prints MAG lines as grams, not bars

Prod order bad49a91 (2026-11-07 22:01 SGT): 2 g of MAG on the 100 g PAMP
listing, S$343.27, was announced as "2x 100 Gram PAMP Cast Bar" - it reads as
two 100 g bars. The order itself is correct (total_grams 2, 2 g allocated at
S$171.64/g, COD as the checkout allows for MAG). A MAG line's quantity is
grams and its label is the bar they accumulate toward, so the alert now says
"2g MAG (100 Gram PAMP Cast Bar)" (alertLineLabel; tested).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENy7mcyRcPVBTHa8uTL

* fix(orders): a MAG line is never presale

Prod order bad49a91 (2026-11-07): the first web MAG order recorded
fulfillment_type "presale" and is_presale on its line, and the new-order alert
said "presale". A MAG listing is a bar already held in the vault
(mag_listings.inventory_id + serial 100G-4FWJ-7XGM); the MAG catalogue
product just carries status "presale". The two admin-entered MAG orders were
"immediate".

lib/presale.ts: isPresaleProduct (presale status AND not MAG) and
fulfillmentTypeFor - now the only presale rule in orders/create, the shared
gateway create, Stripe create-intent and the HitPay order line. Tests pin the
rule and that every path uses it. Receipts never showed presale; the admin
presale badge and the alert did.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENy7mcyRcPVBTHa8uTL

* docs: 11-07 evening record — #740 MAG alert + presale fix, bad49a91 corrected

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENy7mcyRcPVBTHa8uTL
